tools.name: check_compensation
tools.description: Check EU261/UK261 compensation eligibility and amount for a delayed or cancelled flight. Give IATA codes; distance is computed for known airports.

tools.name: compensation_table
tools.description: Reference table: EU261/UK261 amounts by distance band, eligibility summary and claim windows.

tools.name: disruption_rights
tools.description: List your rights for a delayed, cancelled or overbooked flight: refund/re-routing, care, compensation and escalation path.

tools.name: claim_timeline
tools.description: Claim deadline guidance and evidence checklist for a flight date.

tools.name: generate_claim_letter
tools.description: Generate a formal compensation claim letter to the airline, citing EU261/UK261 with your flight details filled in.
